name: Bachelor of Education (Foundation Phase)
notes: CAO code KN-E-BFP. Campus: Edgewood. School of Education. APS range 48-28 (excl. LO); minimum 28 does not guarantee acceptance. NCV Level 4 applicants with Bachelor endorsement may apply (pass in LO, 50% English, Level 4 Maths or Level 5 Maths Lit, Level 3 in two other subjects). Foundation and Intermediate Phase students are expected to study English and isiZulu. Technical Mathematics not listed.

name: Bachelor of Education (Intermediate Phase)
notes: CAO code KN-E-BIP. Campus: Edgewood. School of Education. APS range 48-28 (excl. LO); minimum 28 does not guarantee acceptance. NCV Level 4 applicants with Bachelor endorsement may apply (pass in LO, 50% English, Level 4 Maths or Level 5 Maths Lit, Level 3 in two other subjects). p.23 table requires Level 5 (60%) in any two of: Mathematics, Mathematical Literacy, Technology, Life Sciences, Physical Sciences. p.106 states Mathematics Level 4 / Mathematical Literacy Level 5 (used for the maths group). Foundation and Intermediate Phase students are expected to study English and isiZulu. Technical Mathematics not listed.

name: Bachelor of Education (Senior Phase and Further Education and Training)
notes: CAO codes KN-E-BSN / KN-E-FET. Campus: Edgewood. School of Education. APS range 48-28 (excl. LO); minimum 28 does not guarantee acceptance. NCV Level 4 applicants with Bachelor endorsement may apply (pass in LO, 50% English, Level 4 Maths or Level 5 Maths Lit, Level 3 in two other subjects). Also requires Level 5 (60%) in any two NSC subjects relevant to the teaching package selected. No mathematics requirement listed. Technical Mathematics not listed.

name: Bachelor of Arts (General Studies)
notes: CAO codes KN-H-BA2 / KN-P-BA2. Campus: Howard College, Pietermaritzburg. APS range 48-28 (excl. LO). Also requires Level 5 (60%) in one of: any language (HL or FAL), Business Studies, Consumer Studies, Dramatic Arts, Economics, Geography, History, Information Technology, Life Sciences, Mathematics/Mathematical Literacy, Music, Religion Studies, Visual Arts. Selection: meeting the minimum APS does not guarantee acceptance. APS 30 required to take any Law modules (e.g. Legal Studies major). Technical Mathematics not listed.

name: Bachelor of Arts in Music
notes: CAO code KN-H-BAM (p.23); p.111 lists KN-H-BAMUSC. Campus: Howard College. Auditions required. Majors: Performance, Theory and Composition, or Research. No mathematics requirement listed. Technical Mathematics not listed.

name: Bachelor of Arts in Music Foundation
notes: CAO code KN-H-BMX (p.23); p.31 lists KN-H-BAMUS4. Campus: Howard College. Auditions required. Foundation year (128 foundation credits) then BA in Music; minimum four years in total. Preference to Quintile 1-3 schools; other applicants considered if they have no previous formal musical training and show exceptional potential. No mathematics requirement listed. Technical Mathematics not listed.
